# Audit: Release Mode on and off, releasing a middle member, a No, then the last member.
party 1 5
party 4 5
party 7 5
party 25 5
> start
> menu Actions > Release a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to release it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Release Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> menu Actions > Release a POKéMON
dialog information "Release Mode deactivated. Statistics window will now function normally." -> OK
> menu Actions > Release a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to release it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Release Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 2
dialog information "# 004 Charmander, L.5, XP:125, XP to next level:91" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Once released, Charmander will not come back. Release Charmander?" -> Yes
dialog information "Charmander was released. Bye, Charmander!" -> OK
